messages:
acme_dev: Hey @tier2-support / @eng-ml — after the v2 rollout this morning our generated TS from the Assist API is failing CI. Minimal repro below, started right after 08:12 PDT deploy. Any idea?

acme_dev: prompt: `Generate a typescript client for placing orders using our internal SDK. Keep it compact.`

acme_dev: generated output (what we feed to tsc):
```ts
export const placeOrder = async (order: OrderPayload): Promise<OrderResponse> => {
  const client = new OrderClient(process.env.ORDER_ENDPOINT);
  const resp = await client.create(order);
  return resp;
};
```

acme_dev: tsc error: "Cannot find name 'OrderClient'. Did you mean to import it?" — the generator used the type and constructor but omitted the import. This used to include `import { OrderClient } from '@internal/clients'`.

acme_dev: request_id: rq_123abc456, model: redwood-assist-v2, api_version: 2026-03-17

tier2-support: Thanks — sorry for the break. Can you confirm if the same prompt gave a working client yesterday? Also can you paste the full response payload you receive from /v1/assist (including model field and any warnings)?

acme_dev: yes, same prompt worked yesterday. Full response attached (stripped logs): model: "redwood-assist-v2", choices[0].content contains the code block above, no import lines, no extra comments. No warnings in response.

samir-eng: I can repro locally with the provided request_id. Looks like the model's post-processing that injects required imports didn't run for some completions — output truncated near top-of-file. Possibly regression in the template or tokenizer split earlier than imports. Escalating to eng-ml.

eng-ml: @samir-eng thanks for repro. We're triaging — initial hypothesis: a prompt templating change in the v2 rollout altered the injection anchor for SDK imports. Can you attach the raw tokens around the start of the completion? Also tagging @eng-oncall to see if any rollout hooks changed.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1073 — "Assist: missing imports in generated TS after v2 rollout". Priority: P1. Linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-1073

eng-oncall: We're pulling the rollout diff and will try a hotfix to restore the previous import-injection behavior. If confirmed, we can either rollback the model variant or push a fix to the post-processing layer.

tier2-support: For the customer: immediate workaround is to add the import manually in your codegen pipeline (we know it's annoying). We'll update here with timeline. Sorry for the disruption :disappointed_relieved:

acme_dev: Thanks — manual patch unblocks us but it's a CI stopgap. Please keep this thread updated, our deploys are blocked until this is fixed. Much appreciated.

eng-ml: Update 30m: root cause narrowed to a template anchor mismatch for the SDK import injection. Devs are testing a rollback to the previous template. ETA 2–3 hours for validated rollout/patch.

acme_dev: Appreciate the ETA. We'll monitor.

samir-eng: Adding note for postmortem: check model variant tag mapping during rollout and ensure post-processing anchors have integration tests (token boundary cases).

eng-oncall: Noted — adding to INC-2026-1073.

acme_dev: confirmed after hotfix the generator now includes the import and CI passes. Thanks team! :tada:
